question: The value of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of India is published by PIB in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Indian Rupee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **PIB publishes **the value of the GDP in** the Indian Rupee.**
 
• **Real GDP or Gross Domestic Product (GDP) **in the year** 2020-21** is estimated at** Rs135.13 lakh crore, **as against the First Revised Estimate of **GDP for 2019-20 of Rs.145.69 lakh crore.**
 
• **The growth in GDP during 2019-20 is estimated at -7.3 per cent.**
